title.en: Stockholm Convention on Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs)
title.hi: स्थायी जैविक प्रदूषकों (POPs) पर स्टॉकहोम कन्वेंशन

definition.en: The Stockholm Convention (2001, in force 2004) aims to eliminate or restrict the production and use of Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) characterized by environmental persistence, bioaccumulation, long-range environmental transport, and toxicity.
definition.hi: The Stockholm Convention (2001, in force 2004) aims to eliminate or restrict the production and use of Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) characterized by environmental persistence, bioaccumulation, long-range environmental transport, and toxicity.

content.en: The Stockholm Convention (2001, in force 2004) aims to eliminate or restrict the production and use of Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) characterized by environmental persistence, bioaccumulation, long-range environmental transport, and toxicity.
content.hi: The Stockholm Convention (2001, in force 2004) aims to eliminate or restrict the production and use of Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) characterized by environmental persistence, bioaccumulation, long-range environmental transport, and toxicity.

content.en:
• Targets the original "Dirty Dozen" (including DDT, Dioxins, Furans, PCBs, Aldrin, Dieldrin).
• Annex A (Elimination), Annex B (Restriction - e.g. DDT for disease vector control), Annex C (Unintentional production - Dioxins/Furans from incineration).
• India ratified the convention in 2006 with opt-out clause under Article 25(4) requiring cabinet ratification for new POPs.
content.hi:
• Targets the original "Dirty Dozen" (including DDT, Dioxins, Furans, PCBs, Aldrin, Dieldrin).

question.en:

2. Bioaccumulation in human and animal fatty tissues
3. High water solubility and rapid biodegradation

question.hi:
Which of the following characteristics define Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) under the Stockholm Convention?
1. High environmental persistence
2. Bioaccumulation in human and animal fatty tissues
3. High water solubility and rapid biodegradation
Select the correct answer:

explanation.en: POPs are characterized by high lipophilicity (insoluble in water, accumulating in fat tissues) and resistance to chemical and biological degradation. Statement 3 is false.
explanation.hi: POPs are characterized by high lipophilicity (insoluble in water, accumulating in fat tissues) and resistance to chemical and biological degradation. Statement 3 is false.
